source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Deduction Using Logical Rules with a self-check and a small if-then program of ours (PDF 33, printed 29).

blocks.text: Deduction reasoning ki aisi qism hai jo aam (general) facts se shuru ho kar ek khaas (specific) nateeje tak pohanchti hai. Deduction mein “if-then” (agar-to) jaise logical qaide istemal hote hain. Maslan “Agar barish ho to zameen geeli hoti hai” aur “Barish ho rahi hai” se nateeja nikalta hai “Zameen geeli hai.” Deduction par bharosa kiya ja sakta hai kyunke agar premises sach hon to nateeja yaqeenan sach hota hai. Computer masle hal karne aur sawalon ke jawab dene ke liye deduction istemal karte hain. Deduction formal reasoning aur problem solving ke kaamon mein madad deti hai.

blocks.prompt: “Agar number 4 se poora taqseem (divide) ho to woh even hai. 12, 4 se poora taqseem hota hai.” Kya nateeja nikalta hai? Kya ulti baat “Agar number even ho to woh 4 se taqseem hota hai” sahi hai?
blocks.explanation: Nateeja: 12 even hai. Ulti baat sahi nahi: 6 even hai lekin 4 se poora taqseem nahi hota. Yani “to” wala hissa sach ho to “agar” wala hissa khud sabit nahi hota.

blocks.text: Computer “if-then” qaide se deduction aise karta hai. it_is_raining ki value badal kar dekhein.

it_is_raining = True   # fact: kya barish ho rahi hai?

# Rule: If it rains, the ground gets wet.
if it_is_raining:
    print("It is raining.")
    print("Conclusion: The ground is wet.")
else:
    print("It is not raining. The rule tells us nothing about the ground.")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"it_is_raining = True": fact, yani barish ho rahi hai.
"# Rule: ...": comment; qaida “Agar barish ho to zameen geeli hoti hai”.
"if it_is_raining:": agar fact sach hai to qaide ka “then” hissa chalta hai aur nateeja print hota hai.
else: barish na ho to yeh qaida zameen ke baare mein kuch nahi batata (zameen kisi aur wajah se bhi geeli ho sakti hai).
Output: "It is raining." aur "Conclusion: The ground is wet."
Khud try karein: it_is_raining = False likh kar Run karein: "It is not raining. The rule tells us nothing about the ground." aayega.

items: Deduction: aam qaida + khaas fact = khaas nateeja.
Premises sach hon to nateeja yaqeenan sach.
Computer if-then qaidon se yahi karta hai.
